description: Real-time and historical Citi Bike station availability for NYC
title: Citi Bike Station Overview

list.definition: SELECT station_id AS __value, name AS __text FROM stations ORDER BY name
list.label: Station
list.name: station_id
list.query: SELECT station_id AS __value, name AS __text FROM stations ORDER BY name

panels.title: Station Map — Current Fill Level
panels.description: Each bubble is a station; color = fill % (red = empty, green = full). Bubble size scales with capacity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.lat         AS latitude,
  s.lon         AS longitude,
  s.name,
  s.capacity,
  COALESCE(ss.bikes_available, 0)                                               AS bikes_available,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ss.bikes_available, 0) / NULLIF(s.capacity, 0))::int  AS fill_pct
FROM stations s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT bikes_available
  FROM   station_snapshots
  WHERE  station_id = s.station_id
  ORDER  BY time DESC
  LIMIT  1
) ss ON true

SELECT
  time_bucket('10 minutes', time) AS "time",
  AVG(bikes_available)            AS "bikes_available",
  AVG(docks_available)            AS "docks_available"
FROM station_snapshots
WHERE station_id = '${station_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly Pattern — ${station_id:text}
panels.description: Average fill rate (bikes / capacity) by hour of day, broken out by day of week. Uses all available history for the selected station.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(time, 'HH24') || ':00'                                                                                       AS hour_of_day,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 1 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Mon",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 2 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Tue",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 3 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Wed",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 4 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Thu",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 5 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Fri",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 6 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Sat",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM time) = 0 THEN bikes_available::float / NULLIF(capacity, 0) END) * 100, 1)  AS "Sun"
FROM station_snapshots ss
JOIN stations s USING (station_id)
WHERE ss.station_id = '${station_id}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
